prompts.text: What is the most confident thing you have ever done to get someones attention?
Describe your ideal date night in as much detail as you are comfortable sharing.
What is a compliment you have received that you still think about to this day?
Whisper a cheesy pickup line into the microphone in your most serious voice.
What is the boldest text you have ever sent, and did you ever send it?
Recreate a flirtatious glance across the room for the exact length of one long breath.
What is something you find genuinely attractive that most people would find boring?
Send a wholesome but flirty message to the chat and let the group rate it.
What is the most daring thing you have done on a first date, if you have ever had one?
Describe your celebrity crush in a way that makes them sound like a perfect ten.
What song would you put on to set the mood and why that specific song?
Hold the gaze of the camera for ten seconds without cracking a smile.
What is a secret passion of yours that you only reveal to very close friends?
Give the group your best advice on asking someone out, using a real example.
What is the most spontaneous romantic gesture you have ever done or received?
Describe your proudest confidence moment and relive it with the group for a minute.
